title: CarryOverMemoryAssignedPayload

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

repositoryIdentity.description: The repository the folder was assigned to: its key.

folder.description: The project folder the memory lies in, by its name under projects/: what carryOver.assignMemory takes.

path.description: The memory folder itself, projects/<folder>/memory in the adopted directory.

key.description: The auto-memory key it went to: the repository identity, else the main checkout, else the path a transcript named.

outcome.description: What a memory folder's copy did: copied, its files into its key's auto-memory directory, which held nothing; carried, whole under carried/ in that directory with a pointer line appended to its MEMORY.md, the directory holding other memory; kept, nothing copied, the directory holding it already or the folder unchanged since an import last copied it there.

under.description: Where in the key's directory a carried folder landed, carried/<name>; null when it was copied or kept.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the folder's files as the copy read them, their paths and bytes: an import leaves a folder with a digest already copied to the same key alone.

copy.description: A memory folder copied by the carried/ rule: the folder, the key it went to, what the copy did and a digest of what it read.

description: carry-over.memory-assigned: a memory folder no transcript maps was assigned to a repository and copied into its auto memory: the account, the repository, and what the copy did.
